mapper.select: select RULE_ID as ruleId, COLUMN_NO as columnNo, COLUMN_NAME as columnName, TARGET_COLUMN as targetColumn, WORKFLOW_ID as workflowId from EXCEL_IMPORT_RULE_DETAIL where STATUS = 'E' and RULE_ID = #{ruleId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT distinct B.COLUMN_NAME FROM USER_TAB_COLUMNS A, USER_IND_COLUMNS B WHERE A.TABLE_NAME = B.TABLE_NAME AND A.TABLE_NAME = #{tableName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT distinct A.TABLE_NAME as tabName, A.COLUMN_NAME as colName, A.COLUMN_ID as colNo, A.DATA_TYPE as typeName, A.DATA_LENGTH as length, A.DATA_SCALE as scale, A.NULLABLE as nulls, B.COMMENTS as remarks FROM USER_TAB_COLUMNS A, USER_COL_COMMENTS B WHERE A.TABLE_NAME=B.TABLE_NAME AND A.COLUMN_NAME=B.COLUMN_NAME AND A.TABLE_NAME = #{tableName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY A.COLUMN_ID

select a.RULE_ID, a.COLUMN_NO, a.COLUMN_NAME, a.TARGET_COLUMN, a.RULE_DETAIL_ID, b.RULE_DETAIL_ID DETAIL_RULE_DETAIL_ID, b.COLUMN_VALUE, b.TARGET_VALUE from VAL_EXCEL_RULE_DICTCODE a left join VAL_EXCEL_RULE_DICTCODE_DETAIL b on b.RULE_DETAIL_ID = a.RULE_DETAIL_ID where a.RULE_ID = #{ruleId} and a.STATUS = 'E' and b.STATUS = 'E'

select a.RULE_ID ruleId, a.COLUMN_NO columnNo, a.COLUMN_NAME columnName, a.TARGET_COLUMN targetColumn, a.MASTER_DATA_TABLE masterDataTable, a.MASTER_DATA_ID_COLUMN masterDataIdColumn, a.MASTER_DATA_NAME_COLUMN masterDataNameColumn from VAL_EXCEL_RULE_MASTER_DATA a where a.RULE_ID = #{ruleId} and a.STATUS = 'E'
select a.RULE_ID ruleId, a.TARGET_COLUMN targetColumn, a.CUSTOM_SQL customSql from VAL_EXCEL_RULE_CUSTOM_SQL a where a.RULE_ID = #{ruleId} and a.STATUS = 'E'
